STRATEGY: The parent is a forgiving strategy that cooperates and retaliates only when opponent defection rate reaches a threshold. The trace simulates a probe-and-adapt strategy against the 12 opponents, then revises it to cooperate until late, probe once, and exploit if the opponent does not retaliate.

STRATEGY: Parent is essentially TFT with two-tat punishment and endgame defection, scoring 269.88. Simulated against TFT, parent, always-defect, and forgiving opponents. Changed by adding a mid-game probe (defect at round 20), a two-round forgiveness rule after retaliation, exploitation with 1/3 defection once a successful probe is detected, and endgame defection at rounds 99-100.
